license_evidence.scope: Claude Sonnet 5.5 API access and related Anthropic services

access_boundary: This record represents the Claude Sonnet 5.5 release of September 28, 2026, the second model of the Claude 5.5 family with the pinned claude-sonnet-5-5 API identifier and per-platform IDs on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS. The reviewed Sonnet 5, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 5.5 lines, the unlaunched Claude Haiku 5.5, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Dated first-party announcement and docs page with per-platform model identifiers, an active latest status, and a retirement commitment of no sooner than September 28, 2027
Served on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS
tradeoffs: Closed weights served only through managed APIs
Five documented breaking changes from Sonnet 5, including forced tool use returning an error and up-front thinking requiring the new between_tools setting
